object.attr: analysis: a lenient reader also takes '+7', ' 7', '1_000' and other scripts' digits, which then compare wrongly in filters (CF-C19). Leading zeros and -0 fit. USAGE says only "base-10 signed digits" (review Q23).
object.description: If an object's non-blank value for an integer attribute isn't an optional minus sign followed by one or more ASCII digits, Mellon shall report the validation error ATTR_BAD_INTEGER.
